title: Do you want a date?
statementMd:
Leha decided to move to a quiet town Vičkopolis, because he was tired by living in Bankopolis. Upon arrival he immediately began to expand his network of hacked computers. During the week Leha managed to get access to $*n*$ computers throughout the town. Incidentally all the computers, which were hacked by Leha, lie on the same straight line, due to the reason that there is the only one straight street in Vičkopolis.

Let's denote the coordinate system on this street. Besides let's number all the hacked computers with integers from $1$ to $*n*$. So the $*i*$-th hacked computer is located at the point $*x*_{*i*}$. Moreover the coordinates of all computers are distinct.

Leha is determined to have a little rest after a hard week. Therefore he is going to invite his friend Noora to a restaurant. However the girl agrees to go on a date with the only one condition: Leha have to solve a simple task.

Leha should calculate a sum of $*F*(*a*)$ for all $*a*$, where $*a*$ is a non-empty subset of the set, that consists of all hacked computers. Formally, let's denote $*A*$ the set of all integers from $1$ to $*n*$. Noora asks the hacker to find value of the expression ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c34dec8c1b7fcd87d979d9ee754ed6bccf74dbaf.png). Here $*F*(*a*)$ is calculated as the maximum among the distances between all pairs of computers from the set $*a*$. Formally, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/27a60caeac865f8d46f6a4e1f522eacb08256443.png). Since the required sum can be quite large Noora asks to find it modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

Though, Leha is too tired. Consequently he is not able to solve this task. Help the hacker to attend a date.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5})$ denoting the number of hacked computers.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$ denoting the coordinates of hacked computers. It is guaranteed that all $*x*_{*i*}$ are distinct.

## Output

Print a single integer — the required sum modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

There are three non-empty subsets in the first sample test:![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/02b2d12556dad85f1c6c6912786eb87d4be2ea17.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22f6a537962c86b3e28ddb8aaca28a7cdd219a8c.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d0f73b3e94e13cb797f39e93d9da74835c5a02d.png). The first and the second subset increase the sum by $0$ and the third subset increases the sum by $7 - 4 = 3$. In total the answer is $0 + 0 + 3 = 3$.

There are seven non-empty subsets in the second sample test. Among them only the following subsets increase the answer: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f368c407c8e85e2b5fedfffaff39d471d765f026.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb8f2118a3ac352db393b1f067b28e398ce7f816.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/049032074c04b16bc0cc153f95471c40b222072b.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dc93c7f5b3d122314c9c5a707fae556a8f72a574.png). In total the sum is $(4 - 3) + (4 - 1) + (3 - 1) + (4 - 1) = 9$.
statementZhMd:
Leha 决定搬到安静的小镇 Vičkopolis，因为他厌倦了在 Bankopolis 生活。到达后，他立即开始扩展自己的被黑计算机网络。在这一周里，Leha 成功获得了全镇 $*n*$ 台计算机的访问权限。巧合的是，由于 Vičkopolis 只有一条笔直的街道，Leha 黑入的所有计算机都位于同一直线上。

让我们在这条街道上建立坐标系。此外，我们用从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数为所有被黑的计算机编号。因此，第 $*i*$ 台被黑的计算机位于点 $*x*_{*i*}$。并且，所有计算机的坐标互不相同。

辛苦了一周后，Leha 决定好好休息一下。因此，他打算邀请朋友 Noora 去餐厅。然而，这个女孩同意约会的唯一条件是：Leha 必须解决一道简单的题目。

Leha 需要计算所有 $*a*$ 对应的 $*F*(*a*)$ 之和，其中 $*a*$ 是由所有被黑计算机组成的集合的一个非空子集。形式化地，令 $*A*$ 表示从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的所有整数构成的集合。Noora 要求这位黑客求出表达式 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c34dec8c1b7fcd87d979d9ee754ed6bccf74dbaf.png) 的值。其中，$*F*(*a*)$ 定义为集合 $*a*$ 中所有计算机两两之间距离的最大值。形式化地，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/27a60caeac865f8d46f6a4e1f522eacb08256443.png)。由于所求的和可能非常大，Noora 要求将答案对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。

然而，Leha 太累了。因此，他无法解决这道题。请帮助这位黑客成功赴约。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5})$，表示被黑的计算机数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$，表示被黑计算机的坐标。保证所有 $*x*_{*i*}$ 互不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——所求的和对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

第一个样例测试中有三个非空子集：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/02b2d12556dad85f1c6c6912786eb87d4be2ea17.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22f6a537962c86b3e28ddb8aaca28a7cdd219a8c.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7d0f73b3e94e13cb797f39e93d9da74835c5a02d.png)。前两个子集对总和的贡献都是 $0$，第三个子集的贡献为 $7 - 4 = 3$。因此，答案为 $0 + 0 + 3 = 3$。

第二个样例测试中有七个非空子集。其中只有以下子集会对答案产生贡献：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f368c407c8e85e2b5fedfffaff39d471d765f026.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb8f2118a3ac352db393b1f067b28e398ce7f816.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/049032074c04b16bc0cc153f95471c40b222072b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/dc93c7f5b3d122314c9c5a707fae556a8f72a574.png)。总和为 $(4 - 3) + (4 - 1) + (3 - 1) + (4 - 1) = 9$。
